stages.description: Ordered steps: { key, label, value? , values? }. Use value without segments, values keyed by segment with them.

segments.description: Parts of every step, such as devices: { key, label }. Leave it out for one total per step.

label.description: What is counted. Names the chart, the summary, and the table.

unit.description: Noun after counts in the tooltip and table, such as "sessions".

view.description: "total" draws one band, "split" stacks every segment with a gap, and a segment key isolates it and rescales the band to fill the height.

flow.description: Dots that stream through the band. Each decides up front where it leaves, so the falling share matches the real drop-off.

orientation.description: Auto turns the funnel vertical below 420px of container width, with steps listed down the side.

height.description: Band area thickness in pixels when horizontal.

formatValue.description: Formats counts. Defaults to compact numbers in headings and full numbers in the tooltip.

onActiveChange.description: Called as the step in focus changes.

emptyLabel.description: Message when the first step is zero.
